fomod.Name: SeverActions - SkyrimNet Action Pack
fomod.Author: Sever
fomod.Description:
A comprehensive action, prompt, and behavior pack for SkyrimNet. 118 actions (Sever's Hearth's 7 included), 78 prompt templates, and a native C++ SKSE plugin (about 1,200 Papyrus-callable functions). NPCs can follow, travel, craft, cook, brew, read books aloud, manage outfits with presets and persistent outfit locking, handle gold and debts, use furniture, fight and brawl, get arrested and escorted to jail, run businesses for you, and more - all driven naturally through conversation. Includes a companion framework with relationship tracking, automatic LLM-based relationship assessment and survival needs, and coexists with Nether's Follower Framework (a follower NFF manages is dismissed, told to wait and resumed through NFF's own controller). Features a debt tracking system with credit limits, due dates, recurring charges, and guard reports for overdue debts. Game state lives in the SKSE co-save and survives save/load. The in-game interface is Magelight UI, bundled and installed with the core; the MCM (SkyUI) remains available. Optional adult content modules included.
Credits: - Cartography by Caro Tuts (Skyrim Paper Map for FWMF, Nexus #62705) — used as the base map for the World page. - Hold sigils derived from CoMAP map markers by Parapets (Nexus #56123) and Cities of the North marker pack — re-tinted to a parchment palette for the World page. - Imperial Fiscal Levy armour meshes and textures by NordwarUA (New Legion, Nexus #30468 — Base and Textures HD archives) — recoloured to a Treasury livery for the Final Audit detail. - The General's writ-blade mesh and textures by InsanitySorrow (Insanity's Ebony Sword Replacer, Nexus #37645) — recoloured to match the Treasury livery. - The Legates' blades by billyro (Mage Glass Sword, Nexus #38798) — re-tinted storm-blue for Livia and ember for Drusilla.
